attribution: Both frozen routes order correctly whenever all three exact prompt-derived labels survive. Every functional failure is caused by omission or corruption of at least one exact label. The current blocker is therefore prompt-span realization at the execution-host boundary, not observed ordering conditional on exact copying.
authorized_successor_design: One generic evaluator-blind prompt-bound span-pointer feasibility protocol may be designed. It must extract only literal bracketed spans from the prompt, use the frozen adapted model to rank all six permutations, emit exact prompt spans, and report quality plus scoring cost. It is a host-interface diagnostic, not an ABI artifact or LayerCake product implementation.
claim_boundary: Valid mechanism attribution only; no repaired host, ABI candidate, stable frontier, runtime pass, matched baseline, final test, Phase 4 certificate, or superiority claim.
